scope: Read-only static JS source-registration audit; no builds/tests/runtime probes/code generation/Git mutations. Only private audit docs/metadata written.
sourceRoot: verified upstream source archive at recorded commit; selected files in third_party/nodejs/upstream
provenanceLimit: Read existing verified provenance; no fresh network/signature/tarball-hash or source-tree-hash verification. Manifest hashes identify current source bytes.
defaultManifestDefinition: Every lib JS/MJS recursively except lib/eslint.config_partial.mjs, 14 fixed deps, 2 shareable defaults, no linked modules.
registrationAnchors: tools/js2c.cc:80-130,909-953 (recursive JS/MJS, excluded lint file, stable separate sorting)
src/node_builtins.cc:341-408 (node:<id> compilation origin and engine functions/modules)
idMapping: lib/a/b.js -> a/b; deps/a/b.js -> internal/deps/a/b; .mjs suffix also stripped. Other optional linked file names retain path minus suffix. Registry keys lack node: prefix; compiler origins are node:<id>.
C++ variable names replace dot/hyphen/slash with underscore; these names are implementation storage, not public module IDs.
Upstream realm decides node: aliases/public/internal/prefix-only/experimental policy. Do not expose all registered sources through public require.

parameters.kSourceTextModule: Compile as ES module, not CommonJS function

transformations.operation: Source converted into ASCII/Latin1/UTF16 representation. Only Undici is allowlisted for U+2019 -> apostrophe when non-Latin1 branch reached; upstream transforms decoded source text here, so byte-identical source and exact js2c output are distinct policies.
config.gypi: strip # comments, replace quoted true/false with actual JSON booleans, encode separate config resource.

No JS AST rewriting, partial algorithm extraction, minification, or public-API replacement in inspected js2c. Wrapping occurs at engine compilation with source-kind arguments, preserving original body and source lines.

alreadyDistributedBundles.note: Generated upstream bundle already contains base64 Wasm; no external .wasm input missing. Requires WebAssembly.Module/Instance in guest, so nested Wasm can be prerequisite for full TypeScript earlier than node:wasi.
Pinned upstream distribution bundle already present; no local re-bundling needed; its real Node API dependencies still need backend.
Pinned upstream bundle includes balanced-match/brace-expansion; no package install/rebundle needed for source registration; retain notices.
Distributed parser source present in tar; no regeneration needed for registration.

licenses.note: Preserve composite license and file notices: Node MIT plus embedded external lib-derived files (punycode/caja/rimraf/fs-extra/on-exit-leak-free/sonic-boom). Whole lib includes these.
Minimatch BlueOak-1.0.0; bundled balanced-match/brace-expansion notice completeness remains redistribution audit question.

unresolvedChoices: Truthful guest-target generated config and capability branches; embedding Node/Chromium/Firefox/WebKit must not masquerade as native V8/libuv/OpenSSL features. lib/internal/bootstrap/node.js:132-146 freezes builtins.config as process.config; distinct internalBinding(config) also required.
Preserve byte-identical Undici Unicode vs exact upstream js2c apostrophe normalization; document any permitted packaging transform and input/output hashes.

Embedded immutable registry vs guest-VFS source storage; preserve IDs, private internal loader, source origins, module cache, realm ownership, ES-module imports and exact bootstrap/source-kind contracts.
V8 profiling source inclusion is not a promise V8-specific public functionality works on SpiderMonkey; define explicit API-specific engine boundary.
Minimatch bundled transitive-package notice completeness before distribution; this audit is not legal clearance.
Keep optional externalized/linked sources empty initially unless their pinned identity and availability are added to manifest.
Nested guest Wasm remains in scope; Amaro may require ordering earlier if enabling whole upstream TypeScript paths.
evidenceLimits: Only source collection/registration inventoried; no assertion that whole lib is complete runtime, binding closure, or native dependency-build inventory.
All 443 registered JS/MJS source inputs exist in tar index; generated config missing is expected but concrete required input.
File presence/hashes do not prove syntax support, bootstrapping, binding semantics, loading, public API compatibility or four-host conformance.
